proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free credits on signup. Flux-Schnell costs $0.0015 per image (~1200 free images). No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Hosts state-of-the-art open-source image generators (Flux Schnell, SDXL) with incredibly low latency and the lowest pay-as-you-go pricing on the market once free tier is exhausted.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can replace Pollinations in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines via a simple HTTP POST request in GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API keys must be rotated if multiple free accounts are used; ToS allows one account per person.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free credits on signup. Flux-Schnell costs $0.003 per image (~3300 free images).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredibly fast inference times (sub-second for Schnell) and native support for advanced options like ControlNet, IP-Adapter, and image-to-image without complex setup.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into 'produce_tumbler_wraps' or 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' where precise control over composition (via ControlNet) is required.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires GitHub login. Rate limits apply to free tier under heavy platform load.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to upload. No listing fees. 'Printables Store' and 'Clubs' features allow direct monetization with a 10% platform fee.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The fastest-growing 3D printing community, heavily backed by Prusa. Has higher organic engagement and search traffic than Cults3D for functional and artistic STL/3D files.
proposals.would_integrate_where: New distribution channel for 'produce_stl_parametric' or any 3D asset pipeline generated via OpenSCAD/Python.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict moderation on spammy/low-effort procedural uploads. Models must be functional or highly aesthetic.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list. No listing fees. Commission-based model (30% to 35% on exclusive listings, 45% on non-exclusive).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute largest marketplace for PDF tabletop games, print-and-play assets, maps, and coloring pages aimed at fantasy/RPG geeks. Extremely high conversion rate for niche PDFs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can host digital versions of 'produce_card_game', PDF coloring books, or paper miniatures generated in our pipelines.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires manual account setup and initial product approval. Digital files must meet PDF/X print standards.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $0/month. 5% + 50c per transaction. Unlimited products and file hosting up to 5GB.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record (MoR), meaning they handle EU VAT/sales taxes automatically. Essential for a solo developer in France selling digital assets globally without tax nightmares.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Acts as the unified checkout engine for selling gamedev assets, STL packs, and custom PDFs directly from Hugo's GitHub Pages or social media.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds apply (minimum $50 or weekly schedules). Strict policy against copyright-infringing AI assets.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (even heavy JS-rendered pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown with a simple `https://r.jina.ai/URL` prefix.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to scrape e-commerce trend blogs and competitor stores directly from GitHub Actions without writing complex parsers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some highly protected sites (like Cloudflare-protected competitor stores) might still block the request.
